# StudyStack

> > StudyStack is an educational platform offering free flashcards and study games across geography, science, and academic subjects with interactive learning tools.

The platform provides customizable flashcards covering topics from US and world geography to genetics, urban planning (AICP), and physical science. Students can create, share, and study flashcard sets using various game-based learning modes to reinforce knowledge retention.

## Key Topics

- Geography flashcards
- US states and capitals
- Physical geography
- World geography
- Airport codes (IATA)
- Cultural geography
- Climate systems
- AICP exam preparation
- Genetics and medical conditions
- Landforms and water features
- Study games and tools
- AP Human Geography
- Geography vocabulary
- Interactive learning

## Geography Study Resources

- [Free Geography Flashcards](https://www.studystack.com/category-1): Geography study resources: AP Human Geography, AICP, US Census materials
- [Geography Terminology and Concepts](https://www.studystack.com/flashcard-4498650): Geography terminology: Antarctic/Arctic Circle, latitude-longitude concepts
- [Geography Vocabulary](https://www.studystack.com/flashcard-4486469): Elementary geography vocabulary from Social Studies Alive 3rd edition

## United States Geography

- [US States and Capitals Quiz](https://www.studystack.com/flashcard-3990330): US states and capitals quiz: Delaware, New Jersey, New York flashcards
- [Southeast US States and Capitals](https://www.studystack.com/flashcard-12568): Southeast US states and capitals: Virginia, West Virginia, Kentucky
- [Texas Geography](https://www.studystack.com/flashcard-3097812): Texas regions flashcards: Mountains/Basins, Coastal/Great Plains
- [American West Geography](https://www.studystack.com/flashcard-4453550): American West geography: Rocky Mountains, Pacific Ocean, Southern Plains
- [Social Studies Vocabulary](https://www.studystack.com/flashcard-4219181): Social studies vocabulary: Atlantic Coastal Plain, Carolina Bay landforms

## World Geography

- [Australia Geography](https://www.studystack.com/flashcard-4387044): Australia geography: Great Barrier Reef, Uluru, Queensland landmarks
- [Africa Geography Vocabulary](https://www.studystack.com/flashcard-4644992): Africa geography vocabulary: Egypt, North Africa, Southwest Asia terms
- [Europe Test Preparation](https://www.studystack.com/flashcard-4504625): Europe test prep: Iberian Peninsula, UK, Germany, Chernobyl disaster
- [Asia Geography Vocabulary (Portuguese)](https://www.studystack.com/flashcard-4376911): Asia geography in Portuguese: Himalayas, Huang He, Ganges River, monsoons

## Physical Geography and Climate

- [Water and Landforms](https://www.studystack.com/flashcard-4500753): Physical geography: water features and landforms flashcards
- [Climate Systems](https://www.studystack.com/flashcard-4531872): Climate systems: greenhouse effect, hydrological cycle, rainfall patterns
- [Geography Chapter 4 Review](https://www.studystack.com/flashcard-4514471): Chapter 4 review: population, cultural, economic geography flashcards

## Airport and City Codes

- [Airport Codes Quiz 1](https://www.studystack.com/flashcard-4346438): Airport codes flashcards for Lehigh Valley, Allentown, Bethlehem airports
- [US City Airport Codes](https://www.studystack.com/flashcard-4346754): US city airport codes: Seattle, Louisville, Savannah, San Antonio, San Diego

## Optional

- [Genetics Exam 2](https://www.studystack.com/flashcard-4641951): Genetics exam flashcards covering Cystic Fibrosis, Marfan syndrome, dystrophy
- [AICP 2011 Exam Preparation](https://www.studystack.com/flashcard-734978): AICP 2011 exam prep: RCRA, EPA, urban planning regulations flashcards
